en: It's just me and my doddering old father, but do come in.
I was just hoping for a nice long chat
about antiques with you, sir. I'm delighted.
And do drop by the shop, too!
Foolish human, blinded by greed.
Once you are my servant, your greed will fade.
What a kindness I've done him, if I say so myself.
Hahahaha...
How very amusing!
note: follows #4487 after a pause on the same line (player laughing)

en: What can I do for you, young sir?
No, I only came to look around today.
If I find something I like, I'll buy it, though.
You always look so very distinguished.
Young as you are, you like antiques, sir?
Though if I see something I like, I'll take it.
I'll obey your orders, even at the cost of my life...
Hack, hack... My whole body aches...
It's agony...
, my master. As you wish...
note: after the name, servant mode as #0

en: I feel so sluggish, and my whole body aches.
Perhaps my time is drawing near...
Oh... Welcome.
What might you be looking for?
No, I've only come to look today.
Standing is hard on an old man, so
I'll just sit myself down in this chair.
Do call me if you need anything.
How good of you to come.
Please, browse the shop at your leisure.
Yes, I'll do that.
Is the other half of the shop a pawnshop?
That's right. My son runs it.
Lazy and greedy, he's a good-for-nothing.
He even pokes his nose into this shop of mine.
It's truly shameful.
Has my son Will been causing you trouble
lately? I'm terribly sorry.
Please forgive him, for this old man's sake.
And don't let it keep you from the shop.
I'm an old man, you see, so I never even
go out. Meeting customers like you is
my one and only pleasure.
I'm grateful just to have you visit.
I do hope you'll keep coming back.
Good day. What brings you here?
The antique shop is only open by day.
I'd be glad if you came in opening hours.
That work's hard on an old man, too...
Let's meet at the shop around midday.
Why, it's you, sir. Thank you as always.
I'm sorry, but I can't open the shop
outside opening hours...
And it seems my fool of a son has been
causing you trouble. I'm terribly sorry.
I beg you, please forgive him.
Oh, my faithful customer...
Would you care for some tea?
I hope we'll see you again.
Hello. I'll just have a little look around.
Yes, of course.
Thank you. I'll do just that.
So the other half of the shop is a pawnshop.
Oh, my faithful customer... Thank you
so much. Would you care for some tea?
If an old man's company suits you, that is.
Even an old man like this...
must I take him with my own hands...?
I have to do this.
That much is certain.
But I wonder... for us, who must do this,
isn't our existence as vampires
unforgivable
in and of itself...?
The jewels we carry here are all
pieces favoured by nobles and royalty,
every last one of them.
Please, take your time and look them over.
Sir, might I suggest a ring from this case?
What do you think?
